item.content:encoded:
When I heard 'golden disk with patterns', I immediately thought SCP-271 and, by association, most of the rest of the CotBG paraphernalia, including SCP-217. Having already read the last lines of the tale (as is my habit), I assumed that the CotBG had somehow found out about this dying civilization, and had launched a rocket thinger to it containing these, in order to convert an entire planet into clockwork. And now that civilization is coming for us…

But then I read it, and this is also good. Upvoted wholeheartedly despite initial misconceptions.

This post is intended, not a bump as such - I have taken it upon myself to return to Scp after a long break and re-read the first thing I ever found on this site, and now two years after I first became inspired by this story - I still get that odd tingle of hope and inspiration in the back of my brain, it is a shame it never got published - but here I am, re-reading it again.

Thank you Light, for this story - even if it was intended for another, this is what brought me here.

item.content:encoded:
This is great! It feels like old school, golden age Sci-Fi at it's best. You get the occasional hints ("Upper eye…wtf?"), but the big bang is held off perfectly. I can see how this would be uplifting, in a way…but i find it chilling. These beings have ashed out their own world, and are dieing. A drowning man will often drown or seriously injure their rescuer in their mad flailing to get up and away from the water, and in to the air, often drowning them both. What will happen when a whole planet of drowning beings suddenly realizes that there is another place, one of safety and plenty…

Gave me a good shiver, excellent work!!
